reviews.title: Stop thinking about it and buy it
reviews.comment: Lots of space and room for expansion. The quality of the case and ease of getting everything installed were top notch. The air flow is excellent. No complaints.
reviews.author: Jeremy Alford

reviews.title: A great and stylish case
reviews.comment: The case is sleek and very easy to work with. Built in cable management supplies, optional disk drive holders, and tons of space allow this case to be worth the money on functionality alone.
reviews.author: Truman Douglas

reviews.title: This case is GREAT!!!
reviews.comment: Personally, I am all about practicality.  I think things have gone a bit too far with all the extra RGB lights that people put in their cases but to each their own.  I am not bad-mouthing anyone who has that going on for their system, I am just saying some of it is too much for ME. There is only 1 con that bothers me thus far.  The case comes with a stock vertical mount, however, I don't feel comfortable using it as it positions the GPU too close to the glass for my liking.  Other than that I don't have any other real complaints.  Now that we've got that out of the way, let's move on to what I DO like about the case. The practicality of this case is excellent, the functionality is what I have been looking for for quite some time now.  I am upgrading from an NZXT H510 which was a good case too but my major complaint with it was airflow.  In this case, airflow is not an issue as the front panel is open which allows my Corsair H100i Elite LCD to breathe appropriately. The number 1 feature of the Meshify 2 is modularity.  When you take the case apart you have so much room to work with.  The top cover comes off completely which keeps you from having to contort yourself or move the case a bunch of times in order to get the right angle to plug something in that is hard to reach.  It has so many different configurations you can use for your setup.  There are so many different options from the size of the motherboard you choose to use to drive mount locations/configurations and cable management is a breeze.  The 2 USB 3.0 and Type-C connections on the front panel are an added bonus as well. Shout out to Fractal for a job well done, this case is exactly what I was looking for and suits my needs perfectly.
reviews.author: Snap

reviews.title: Good heavy well ventilated
reviews.comment: Great case, lots of room to breathe, but is very large and quiet heavy. Cable management is good.
reviews.author: ALLEN Family

reviews.title: Clean, spacious case with excellent airflow
reviews.comment: This case arrived in perfect condition and was well packaged. All components and accessories were included, and nothing was damaged or missing. The build quality is solid, and the design is clean and minimal. The airflow is excellent thanks to the mesh front, which is exactly what I was looking for. There’s plenty of space inside for an ATX build, and it looks like cable management will be straightforward. Overall, very satisfied with the purchase. Great value for the price and shipped quickly. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Wayne Martin
